crossRefs.note: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his…
For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ…
For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my…
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
